answer: Every epoch pass is re-bought through three sponsors of the holder's hash-assigned ridge, each locking onyx behind it, forfeited when the sponsoree is judged fake, each lending one oasis per judged epoch of its own tenure. The ridge posts that epoch's rent as base×(1+d/Q), d the oasis demanded and Q its fixed supply: an operator holding k clones adds 3k to d, so the k-th clone pays base×(1+3k/Q) onyx, a bill its other k−1 re-pay every epoch. Its own clones hold no judged tenure to lend, and any it grows forfeits three locks when its fake is judged. A newcomer adds three and pays base.
